title: Computer Education and Skill Development
summary: The Rotary Club of Bombay Airport initiated a Computer Education and Skill Development project during the Regal year to improve access to technology and digital learning across multiple educational and community institutions.
description: The Rotary Club of Bombay Airport initiated a Computer Education and Skill Development project during the Regal year to improve access to technology and digital learning across multiple educational and community institutions. Under the initiative, 10 laptops are being provided at each participating location for computer education and skill development. The project covers institutions including Indian Glory, Kids Bellflower, Kasturba Gandhi, Secondary & Higher Secondary School Parli, Hindu Women’s Hostel, Aesthesis Foundation, Enrich Foundation, Shri Vivekanand High School, Badlapur Taluka School, and Mulund High School. The total notional value of the project is ₹30,00,000, while the cost to the club is zero. MOUs with the participating institutions have either been completed or are under process during the Regal year. The initiative aims to bridge gaps in access to digital resources and provide beneficiaries with opportunities to develop essential computer and technology skills.
location: Indian Glory, Malad Kids Bellflower, Kandivali Kasturba Gandhi Secondary & Higher Secondary School, Parli Hindu Women’s Hostel, Vikramgarh Aesthesis Foundation, Andheri Enrich Foundation Shri Vivekanand High School, Jogeshwari East Badlapur Taluka School, Mulund High School, Mumbai, Maharashtra
